rawContent: I’ve never told MY #metoo story publicly and likely never will. But it has to do with someone taking advantage and a “friend” leaving me somewhere she shouldn’t have, leaving me in a position where my choices where taken from me. This happens far too often to women.

@mauthomas How many rappers talk about their crimes of drug dealing, robbery, beating people up, etc on wax? All your favs have done so. Are you looking for them to be held accountable? Or are you trying to prove a reverse #metoo?
